title: 2nd Annual Community Halloween Party
note: Neighbors, families and good times at the new Gardens Park: a jumper for the kids, ice cream, hamburgers & hot dogs, beer & wine for the adults, and a DJ for music and dancing. All are welcome.
flyerAlt: Flyer for the 2nd Annual Community Halloween Party: Saturday, October 31, 6 to 10 PM at Gardens Park. Everything on it is written out in the text beside it.
priceNote: Your contribution covers the food, drinks, entertainment and activities for the evening.
rsvp: Put your family / last name in the Zelle memo — that's how the guest list is built and how the committee tracks who has paid. Once payment is received, your family is added to the party guest list.
details: Come dressed to impress! Prizes for Best Family/Group Costume, Scariest Costume, Most Creative Costume, and Best Kids' Costume.
The committee would love a few volunteers to help BBQ for the community. Willing to take a shift at the grill? Let them know in the community group chat.
In the works for the little ones. Want to participate, help organize, or have another fun Halloween idea? Drop it in the group chat.
host: Run by the Tesoro Highlands event committee. This site only shares the details — payments and the guest list go through the committee.
